text:
deploy-bot: Canary check: p95 latency +42% vs canary baseline, errors 0.32% (threshold 0.2%). Suggestion: shift traffic back to v3.5.7 and reduce canary to 0% :warning:
elyse: Confirming grafana — p95 jump lines up with canary rollout time. looks kv-cache churny on the new kernel flags.
mike: Any sign it's customer-facing or synthetic-only?
elyse: A few customer requests hit elevated latency, not mass errors but noticeable tail.
sam: We have change window open for another 18m, deploybot auto-rollback is enabled. Thoughts on letting bot do it vs manual?
oncall-bot: Auto-rollback policy: enabled when error_rate > 0.25% and sustained for 3m. Condition met at 1712123420.
jordan: Prefer manual for this one — don't want an automated revert to cause extra churn mid-window. We should pin dedicated pools first.
tara: If we pin, do we need a rollback playbook for Dedicated customers? Some have pinned resource reservations that might mismatch.
mike: OK stepwise: 1) Hold further rollout, 2) pin canary traffic to v3.5.7 for all Dedicated pools, 3) run controlled rollback on hosted after ops signoff.
elyse: Agreed. I'll run the hold and pin now.
elyse: /deploy hold --release v3.6.0 --reason "canary p95 spike"
deploy-bot: Command accepted: rollout_hold applied to v3.6.0 at 1712123465 by elyse. Current canary traffic frozen.
elyse: /infra pin-version --pool dedicated-usw2 --version v3.5.7 --note "safety pin; investigating kv-cache effect"
 oncall-bot: Pin job started, ETA ~2m.
tara: I'll draft customer comms for Dedicated customers — short note that we're pausing rollout due to latency spike and we pinned to last stable. Jordan please review.
jordan: Review complete, send from eng-release alias. Keep wording: "no data loss, brief pause, mitigation in progress".
sam: Runbook action: run quick smoke on staging canary with kernel flag off, compare p95. If good, we can schedule a quiet re-rollout in off-peak.
mike: Also add token-level cost telemetry to the postmortem so we can see if batching or kernel paths made costs spike.
elyse: Creating incident doc and postmortem skeleton: https://docs.internal/ops/INC-171212
elyse: tagging #customers-success to prep any inbound questions.
deploy-bot: Note: Auto-rollback remains enabled for non-intervened canaries. Since humans intervened with "hold", auto-rollback suppressed for this release.
jordan: Good. Final: hold in place, dedicated pools pinned, customer comms drafted, runbook actions assigned. We will reconvene at 1712124100 for status update. :white_check_mark:
elyse: update: pin completed for dedicated-usw2 at 1712123500.
sam: smoke tests lined up, starting now.
elyse: thanks all — if smoke passes we'll decide whether to opt for an out-of-window rollforward vs incremental test.
adan: (reaction) :thumbsup:
